final: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories o LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share FROM station_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT s.observstation, s.telescope_count, s.share, s.share - a.value AS share_minus_average FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.value ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC LIMIT 10
